items.prefix_text: I will get straight into it, on Amendment 68, which touches on the important issue of voter participation. The Government are committed to encouraging participation in our democracy and ensuring that every eligible elector is able to vote. The search for quantum advantage in average-case problems is a pressing open question in physics and computer science. The widest conjectured example of such an advantage is in simulation of quantum many-body systems, where sign problems and entanglement growth cause the breakdown of many classical methods. Nonetheless, theoretical evidence for or against such an advantage remains scarce. Here, we investigate this in sparse random non-local Hamiltonians. We design a classical algorithm for such Hamiltonians that enables accurate computation of spectral fluctuations, thermal values, and time-ordered and out-of-time-order correlation functions. In this paper, we rigorously derive this formula from a variational principle based on Arnold's energy--Casimir method, without prescribing any of these geometric or physical quantities a priori. The appearance of a scene is determined by the albedo, roughness, metallicity and normal of every point on its surface, and by the light that reaches it, its irradiance. Recovering these intrinsics from images is ambiguous, and methods that predict them per pixel give the same surface point a different decomposition in every view. A multi-view transformer encodes a set of unposed images, and for any queried surface point, PointX pools the point's tokens across the views in which it appears and decodes the point's intrinsics once. A graduate of the University of Paris, he spent his career promoting third-worldist views, demonstrated by his work at the Institut libre d'étude des relations internationales and the Arab University of Sciences. He also assisted in the drafting of the 1991 Constitution of Burkina Faso, serving as an advisor to President Blaise Compaoré on term limits. He also maintained close ties with North Korea, though his pro-Pyongyang stance led others to label him a "propagandist". Jouve died in Paris on 13 November 2026, at the age of 89. It was established at least in the 14th century and is one of the oldest settlements in the Astravyets District. History Bystrytsa developed near a river rapid of the same name. The settlement is mentioned as early as 1390 as a possession of Jogaila, King of Poland and Grand Duke of Lithuania.
